name: Sudhakar Gaidhani

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sudhakar Gaidhani is a Marathi poet associated with Nagpur, whose work includes the epic Devdoot: The Angel. Its circulation in English and Romanian reflects a sustained life in translation: the Romanian National Library records Liviu Pendefunda’s Romanian version, while translator Datta G. Sawant documents his English translations of the fourth and fifth cantos. In an interview with Yang Yujun, Gaidhani describes his poetic style as philosophical and mystical.

‘AGE CAN BE WASHED LIKE A GARMENT’ gives ageing the familiar gestures of washing, mending and caring for cloth. The worn garment requires tenderness rather than force; the mind becomes both a means of cleansing and a current to which life can be entrusted. Its movement toward evening turns an everyday task into a meditation on release.
